title: Paperless Untagged Document Growth
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=paperless:document
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(tag_count=0)) as untagged_docs by _time
| sort - _time
description: Uses Paperless document metadata telemetry to monitor weekly growth in imported files with no tags in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for searchability problems that accumulate quietly, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Paperless document metadata data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Weekly line chart of untagged documents.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers weekly growth in imported files with no tags so you can spot searchability problems that accumulate quietly before it becomes annoying.
